methods.steps: Open the AI, choose File > Export, select PDF, review the export area and settings, click Export, name the file, and save.
methods.limits: Check how the imported artwork looks before you send the PDF.

methods.steps: Open an AI and choose File > Save a Copy; select Portable Document Format, then review the font, rasterization and page-area options.
methods.limits: Effects that PDF cannot represent may be rasterized.

methods.steps: Open the AI, select File > Export, choose SVG, adjust the area and export settings, click Export, name the result, and save.
methods.limits: An SVG can hold pixel images as well as vector objects, so check the result after the import.

methods.steps: Open an AI and save the drawing with a .svg ending; choose Plain SVG for sharing or Inkscape SVG to keep editor-specific information.
methods.limits: Inspect fonts and effects after the import.

methods.steps: Run apng2gif.exe anim.png anim.gif on Windows; use the installed program name elsewhere.
methods.limits: Keeps the source delays and loop count. The -t threshold and -b background options handle partial transparency.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.apng output.gif.
methods.limits: Reads the APNG sequence and writes an animated GIF. Inspect the colors, since a GIF palette has at most 256.

methods.steps: Run magick apng:input.apng output.gif.
methods.limits: The apng: prefix names the input format, and ImageMagick's format list says reading it needs FFmpeg installed. GIF still has palette and transparency limits.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.avi -c:v libx264 -c:a aac output.mov.
methods.limits: Needs the decoder for the AVI's codec. This makes a new H.264/AAC encoding rather than copying the AVI streams.

methods.steps: Import the AVI, choose File > Export Video, open the Advanced tab, set Video Format to mov, then click Export Video.
methods.limits: The Advanced tab also sets codecs and bitrates.

methods.steps: Run darktable-cli input.dng output.png.
methods.limits: The output extension selects the format. A related XMP sidecar can supply the processing history.

methods.steps: Run magick dng:input.dng output.png.
methods.limits: The DNG format entry requires an explicit input prefix; inspect the resulting default rendering.

methods.steps: Run ps2pdf input.eps output.pdf.
methods.limits: The official usage guide explicitly allows EPS with its PostScript utility scripts. Inspect the page area and resolve missing fonts in the source.

methods.steps: Open EPS, choose File > Export, select PDF, adjust settings and export area, then export and save.
methods.limits: Compare imported artwork and final PDF; font and feature interpretation can affect the result.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.gif -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p output.mov.
methods.limits: The selected pixel format may require even dimensions. This encodes video without creating audio absent from the GIF.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i quicktime.mov -c:a libopus -c:v libvpx-vp9 web-copy.webm.
methods.limits: Requires libvpx-vp9 and libopus support. Uses a different codec combination from the browser tool.

methods.steps: Add the MOV to the project, choose File > Export Video, open the Advanced tab, set Video Format to webm, then click Export Video.
methods.limits: The Advanced tab also sets codecs and bitrates.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i song.mp3 -vn -b:a 192k -c:a aac converted.aac.
methods.limits: Another lossy encode; the target bitrate cannot restore source information. Name the output .m4a for an MP4-based file.

methods.steps: Open the MP3, choose File > Export Audio, and select M4A (AAC) Files as the format.
methods.limits: Needs the optional FFmpeg library. The result is an M4A, not a raw AAC stream.

methods.steps: Open MP3, choose File > Export Audio, select FLAC from Format, review channels, sample rate, bit depth, and level, then export.
methods.limits: FLAC level changes packing efficiency rather than recovering lost MP3 information.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i song.mp3 -vn -c:a flac decoded.flac.
methods.limits: Decodes MP3 then stores its samples losslessly. The FLAC does not become a lossless original recording.
